name: cms-android
description: Android WebView shell for the CMS admin dashboard

scripts.sync: npm run sync:ca && cap sync android
scripts.assets: node scripts/generate-assets.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --android && node scripts/fix-adaptive-icon.mjs
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
